11:00 AM
Letter from the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers
1. The Honorable Speaker will read out the letter received from the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers regarding the assignment.
2. Discussion on the principles and priorities of the Appropriation Bill for the fiscal year 2083/084 (excluding tax proposals) will continue.
3. The Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle will respond to the questions raised in the discussion.
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
